name: Jennea Cannon
summary: In Stormwind's Mage Quarter, Jennea Cannon teaches new mages from the Wizard's Sanctum. She urges caution and self-control, investigates disturbances in local arcane energies, and sends promising apprentices beyond the city to test their studies.

sections.title: A Guide in the Sanctum
sections.body: At the top of the Wizard's Sanctum's spiral walkway, Jennea Cannon teaches those who come to Stormwind to study the arcane. She teaches more than spells. Caution and self-control matter just as much. Even those who do not study magic hear her warning: without training, magic can burn its wielder.

sections.title: Fieldwork and Foundation
sections.body: Jennea sends promising apprentices beyond the city walls to test what they have learned. At Mirror Lake in Elwynn Forest, they study how natural water sources meet arcane resonance. As their studies advance, she sends them to investigate disturbances at the Blue Recluse or gather volatile reagents for their first true wizard's implements.

sections.title: Ties to Greater Masters
sections.body: When an apprentice has outgrown Jennea's lessons, she points the way to greater masters. Those who show true potential may continue up the Sanctum's hierarchy with High Sorcerer Andromath. Others may travel beyond the kingdom to practitioners such as Tabetha, deep in the Dustwallow Marsh.

faq.answer: Jennea Cannon guides new mages and directs early magical research from the Wizard's Sanctum in Stormwind's Mage Quarter.

faq.q: Where can I find Jennea Cannon?
faq.answer: You can find Jennea Cannon inside the Wizard's Sanctum, the spiral tower at the center of Stormwind City's Mage Quarter.

faq.q: What quests does Jennea Cannon offer?
faq.answer: Jennea offers Alliance mages early studies: examining Mirror Lake in Elwynn Forest, investigating strange happenings at the Blue Recluse, and gathering materials for novice mage gear.

faq.q: Why does she send mages to Mirror Lake?
faq.answer: Jennea sends apprentices to fetch a sample from the base of Mirror Lake's waterfall so she can test it for magical taints. She fears altered magic around Stormwind and Elwynn may be seeping into the water.

faq.q: Does Jennea Cannon interact with non-mage classes?
aliases: can non mages talk to jennea
faq.answer: Non-mages can speak with Jennea. She warns them to be cautious around magic, for it burns those without proper training.

faq.q: Who does Jennea Cannon report to?
faq.answer: Jennea guides students within the Wizard's Sanctum until they are ready to study with senior figures such as High Sorcerer Andromath.

angles.text: As a mage, you can look to Jennea for your first field investigations and guidance toward crafting your formal wizard robes and staff.
As an Alliance member, you can find Jennea in Stormwind's Mage Quarter. There she trains new sorcerers to serve the Alliance safely.
